notes:
Snapshot: Platina is a global CX SaaS provider supporting large retail & finance customers. They run a multi-tenant support platform and want to embed a real-time agent-assist layer and automated ticket summarization. Primary ask: RAG pipeline over heterogeneous support KBs with strong citations and freshness guarantees.

Key constraints / asks (from CTO and Head of Support):
- RAG must surface per-claim citations with source granularity (Zendesk article id, Confluence page, S3 object path). Legal wants provenance logs for every suggested claim.
- Freshness window: support articles updated hourly; POC must demonstrate sub-6h ingestion + hot-refresh for critical docs.
- Multi-source retrieval: connectors to Zendesk + Confluence + S3 + internal Postgres. Need metadata filtering (product, country, regulatory tag).
- Citation scoring: prefer top-3 discrete citations, include snippet offsets. Must support exact-match anchor links for agents.
- Agent-assist latency: p99 end-to-end <350ms for short lookups (prefix cache + local KV), graceful degradation to a faster smaller model if overloaded.
- Spike tolerance: platform must handle bursty periods (Black Friday scenario) — estimate up to 5k agent assistance requests/minute for 20m bursts. Need autoscaling & model fallback routing.
- Ticket summarization: multi-turn thread stitching, dedupe of repeated customer messages, redaction of PII in output, summarization templates per SLA tier.
- Tool-calling: integrate with internal ticketing API to create/assign/update tickets. Must support idempotent calls and operator confirmations.
- Audit & retention: every generated answer and citation must be logged for 365 days; retention controls + export (for compliance e-discovery).

Procurement / commercial: they prefer dedicated capacity (predictable cost) but require private deployment in a VPC with customer-managed KMS for keys. Price sensitivity moderate but willing to pay premium for proven spike reliability and auditability. Asked for 12-month commit pricing and uplift for premium SLA.

POC scope (agreed):
- Week 0: provide sample exports (Zendesk CSV, Confluence spaces, S3 snapshots, Postgres sample) and traffic profile (hourly qps + peak burst patterns).
- Week 1: Redwood team to stand up private endpoint in their VPC (test) + ingest 100k doc slices; implement candidate retriever + citation pipeline; deliver agent UI demo.
- Week 2: Run synthetic spike test to 5k req/min, measure latency, token cost, and fallback correctness; run security review checklist with their infosec.

Quotes / snippets from meetings: "We need citations our agents can paste into tickets — not just model hallucinations." — Head of Support.
"Freshness is everything; a stale KB leads to wrong triage and regulatory risk." — CTO.

Blockers today: legal needs confirmation on data residency and KMS flow (their counsel flagged cross-region key escrow). Engineering: needs a clean connector for a legacy Postgres schema (currently behind IP allowlist). Procurement: awaiting final pricing + SLA language.
